headline: Staff to gather information on a former employee's request for medical coverage and union dues reimbursement; no votes taken.
summary: The committee discussed a former employee's request for reimbursement of medical coverage and union dues. It directed staff to obtain relevant information and report back. Discussion of June 2026 meeting agenda correspondence was held in executive session, with any votes deferred to the next meeting.
decisions: Directed staff to obtain relevant information on a former employee's request for reimbursement of medical coverage and union dues and report back.

decision_evidence.quote: Action Item: Obtain relevant information and report back to the Board.

decision_titles: Former employee's request for reimbursement of medical coverage and union dues
